- `stub.PutState()` - deterministic write
- `stub.DelState()` - deterministic write
- `json.Marshal()` on structs (not maps) - deterministic
- `stub.CreateCompositeKey()` - deterministic

All operations are deterministic and there are no patterns from the vulnerability taxonomy present.
